Panftr Player! -Vore Game-

by alsnapz Blue Bird
Posted 11 years ago
Panftr! Spiritual successor to Barbftr, featuring the same wonderful gameplay you're used to with an array of new, interesting creatures!

This is an interactive VORE GAME. It focuses mainly on Endo/Nonfatal vore types.
Special thanks to  ImaginaryZ for coding work! Lord knows this all wouldn't have been possible without his help.

Wanna play it offline? Download the package HERE: https://mega.nz/#!UV5XSQZQ!WO3JjBTvzuJaaEhwssVBAZdiK8C6WLADAy0xbBGESpg

Noone should post their own Panftr players. Contact me to add enemies to the roster.

Current Enemies:
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/17371009/ Grawr
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/17371023/ Dinopotimus
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/17371045/ Ankles
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/17878133/ Snek
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/18008207/ Illumoa Dragon
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/18172663/ Amethyst
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/18634167/ Zibo
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/19088729/ Godran
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/19898426/ Goia
http://www.furaffinity.net/view/20470062/ Sierra


2015-08-11 Update # After countless hours of working on Grawr and plenty on the others, Panftr's initial release is out!
-Includes Grawr, Ankles, and Dinopotimus.
2015-08-23 Update: Therizinosaurs is added thanks to ImaginaryZ. Includes the rudimentary Monster Achievement system.
2015-10-05 Update: Added Snek, thanks to meee! He's not 100% finished just yet, but he is definitely getting there. More will be added to him later! Also this update features darkrolls! Double tap a direction to roll past enemies. Currently unimplemented in all enemies, but it will get there eventually.
2015-10-19 Update: Added Illumao, who is not Illuminati. Also added cave background, and with Illumoa, an actual reason to use the rolls. Added a new nom to Grawr, along with a lay-down belly for his angry swallow belly. Yeah. Try getting him to eat himself to sleep.
2015-11-06 Update: Added Amethyst! Dis burd has a belly that shrinks you if you stick around too long! Have fun playing with dis royal burd.
2015-12-22 Update: Merry Christmas from ImaginaryZ! He added ToughLizard to the roster.
2015-12-28 Update: It's ZIBO!
2016-02-04 Update: Very very very minor. No new enemy, just reuploaded the player to a newer version.
2016-02-13 Update: Added Godran, the noodle dragon, into the game.
2016-04-11 Update: Added a couple of new squishes to snek, a new belly stage to zibo and cuddles on zibo's trip, and an extra swallow animation to Illumi
2016-05-06 Update: Added Goia, and tried to fix the problem with the last update not actually working, which is weird!
2016-07-04 Update: Happy 4th of July! ^3^ Here's a new character, Sierra!
2016-07-13 Update: Added Raiy by darkdeathgrace! This fellow is more about sitting on Pan than eating him, though...
2016-07-26 Update: Hoo boy all these panftr enemies I'm not making! This update is brought to you by Scourge, bringing you a cool enemy to help chill off in these heated summer months!
2016-11-26 Update: Another enemy not by me! Making me start to realize maybe I should actually make something here soon. This enemy by guro2, a dragon named Tesla! ^3^
2017-01-19 Update: Enemy added by Superflame! Welcome, Dra'Zali!
2017-04-19 Update: Tried to add Liz, somehow broke panftr completely instead. No idea how. Will try to fix as soon as possible.

Can i make this work offline somehow?
alsnapz ~alsnapz
OP Blue Bird 11 years ago
If you download all the separate parts (the player, the enemies), put them all in a folder, and then create an .xml file with this in it:

<xml>
<enemy path="pan_ankles.swf" />
<enemy path="pan_dinopotimus.swf" />
<enemy path="panZTherizinosaurus.swf" />
<enemy path="pan_kuiko.swf" />
</xml>

Then it should work offline if you load up the player .swf file.
alsnapz ~alsnapz
OP Blue Bird 11 years ago
PS: The .xml file needs to be named "external"

ImaginaryZ ~imaginaryz
3D Modeller 10 years ago
Welcome to the hell that is flash & CORS. Because playing the flash file comes from the url domain www.furaffinity.net, the links to the external monsters work. if you click download, instead it's that d.facdn url, and the monsters can't be loaded from that domain.

Visually,
furaffinity/mygame.swf
Loads files from:
furaffinity/somemonster.swf
Because the first part matches, so they are in the same domain

You cannot do this thanks to CORS:
d.fcdn/mygame.swf
cannot load from
furaffinity/somemonster.swf
since the first part does not match (this is considered a security violation and blocked... thanks browsers)

And without the furaffinity server having certain crossdomain security .xml files as scripts, this can never be fixed. But if they allowed that, every individual file would need one...

This is a consistent problem with all web tech, it's a security feature but it prevents certain things from existing (most people spend time finding ways around it, which tells you how "secure" it really is)
(more reading https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross.....source_sharing )
